title: Square root of a product of diagonal averages
statement:
Let $k>0$, let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to each point of the $r$-dimensional Boolean cube. For each such point $s$, let $D_k(F_s)$ be the average, over a uniformly chosen base point and $k$ directions in the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, of the product of $F_s$ evaluated at the vertices of the resulting $k$-dimensional cube. Then
\[\sqrt{\prod_{s\in\{0,1\}^r} D_k(F_s)^{1/2^r}}=\prod_{s\in\{0,1\}^r}D_k(F_s)^{1/2^{r+1}}.\]
